Theme & Palette:
- Paper background: #F4F0E8
- Surface cards / container: #FBF9F4
- Dark forest sidebar: #183A32 (deep forest green)
- Ink text: #202724
- Secondary muted text / borders: #536158 and subtle border tones
- Restrained terracotta accent: #A94D36 (used sparingly for primary actions or emphasis)

Typography & Spacing:
- Headlines: Fraunces (serif, editorial tone, e.g. 32px for main title).
- Body: IBM Plex Sans 16px.
- Metadata / captions: 13px.
- Numeric / energy figures: Tabular lining digits.
- Controls / touch targets: minimum 44px height.

Layout Structure:
1. Sidebar (width: 248px, fixed left, dark forest #183A32):
   - Header: Cesta Monogram "C", "Cesta", "ARCHIVO DEL HOGAR".
   - Top CTA button: "Registrar Entrada" (restrained terracotta #A94D36).
   - Module section:
     - "Compra" (collapsed/inactive)
     - "Recetas" (collapsed/inactive)
     - "Calorías" (ACTIVE, highlighted, with dot indicator)
       - Sub-navigation under Calorías:
         * "Mi diario" (ACTIVE item)
         * "Mis alimentos"
         * "Tendencias"
   - Footer links in sidebar:
     - "Ajustes", "Aprender"
     - Subtle badge: "MAQUETA — DATOS DE EJEMPLO"

2. Main Content Area (1192px width, fitting comfortably inside 1440px canvas):
   - Header Bar / Masthead:
     - Top row: Breadcrumb/Category: "Cesta / Cuaderno de Calorías"
     - Visible notice pill: "Maqueta — datos de ejemplo"
     - Date navigation header: "Diario de Alimentación" (Fraunces ~32px), with sleek date switcher: "< Ayer", "Jueves, 24 de Octubre de 2024", "Mañana >", and quick button "Hoy".
     - Privacy reassurance badge alongside the date: a calm pill with lock icon and "Solo tú puedes ver este diario".
     - Serene subtitle in accessible human Spanish: "Anotaciones de ingesta y preparaciones cotidianas. Un registro personal sin metas forzadas ni advertencias."

3. Top Section: "Observación de los últimos 7 días":
   - Clean card (#FBF9F4) with subtle border:
   - Weekly bar visualization showing kcal for the past 7 days:
     - Clean minimalist vertical bars with numbers on top and day labels below (Vie 18: 1.820 kcal, Sáb 19: 2.140 kcal, Dom 20: 1.950 kcal, Lun 21: 1.690 kcal, Mar 22: [GAP - "Pausa natural / Sin registrar"], Mié 23: [Parcial - 1.250 kcal "Registro parcial"], Jue 24 (Hoy): 1.765 kcal [active bar]).
     - Note: Exactly ONE missing-day gap and ONE labelled partial day.
     - Units clearly indicated in kcal.
     - Action link at bottom right: "Ver tabla de datos detallada →".
     - NO 2000 kcal progress rings, NO daily calorie limit indicators, NO red guilt warnings or weight loss advice.

4. Daily Meal Sections (Desayuno, Comida / Almuerzo, Cena):
   - Each meal card on #FBF9F4 paper surface:
     - Meal Header: e.g. "Desayuno", recorded time ("08:30"), and compact known subtotal: "385 kcal".
     - Food item rows:
       * Row 1: "Tostada de pan de masa madre con aceite de oliva virgen extra" | 60 g | 265 kcal | Macros: 5,2g P · 34,0g C · 11,5g G | [Editar] button.
       * Row 2: "Café con leche entera de caserío" | 180 ml | 120 kcal | Macros: 5,8g P · 8,6g C · 6,5g G | [Editar] button.
     - Meal actions row: Buttons "+ Añadir alimento" and "Usar receta guardada" (both min 44px).
   
   - Comida (Almuerzo):
     - Meal Header: "Comida" | recorded at "14:15" | Known subtotal: "820 kcal*" (*con datos pendientes).
     - Row 1: "Guiso casero de verduras de huerta" | 320 g | Macros: "Sin dato" (distinctly marked as Sin dato, NOT 0 or null) | Kcal: "Sin dato".
     - Row 2: "Lomo de lubina al horno con patata panadera" | 220 g | 390 kcal | Macros: 38g P · 22g C · 14g G | [Editar].
     - Row 3: "Rebanada de hogaza de centeno" | 50 g | 135 kcal | Macros: 4,1g P · 26,2g C · 1,1g G | [Editar].
     - Buttons: "+ Añadir alimento", "Usar receta guardada".

   - Cena:
     - Meal Header: "Cena" | recorded at "21:10" | Known subtotal: "560 kcal".
     - Row 1: "Tortilla abierta de dos huevos camperos con espinacas" | 180 g | 290 kcal | Macros: 16,5g P · 2,4g C · 23,0g G | [Editar].
     - Row 2: "Compota casera de manzana reineta templada" | 150 g | 130 kcal | Macros: 0,6g P · 31,0g C · 0,4g G | [Editar].
     - Buttons: "+ Añadir alimento", "Usar receta guardada".

5. Bottom Summary Footer Card:
   - "Resumen de la jornada": Total conocido acumulado "1.765 kcal" (tabular lining numbers), accompanied by macro balance breakdown (Proteínas 69,6 g · Carbohidratos 126,2 g · Grasas 56,5 g + nota: "1 plato pendiente de análisis nutricional etiquetado como Sin dato").
   - Actions: "Exportar día (CSV/PDF)", "+ Registro rápido".

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- No supermarket cart, no grocery store status, no recipe catalogue embedded.
- Human, warm, respectful Spanish language without moralizing or judgmental diet culture vocabulary.

Brand & Style

This design system draws inspiration from historic domestic archives, bound culinary folios, and classical double-entry household ledgers. It is designed for domestic record-keeping across three integrated modules: pantry replenishment (*Compra*), recipe preservation (*Recetas*), and nutritional accounting (*Calorías*).

The emotional tone is quiet, scholarly, grounded, and dignified. It rejects modern digital tropes: no translucent glass panels, no saturated synthetic gradients, no hyper-rounded playful containers, and no gamified guilt metrics. Instead, the interface adopts the physical honesty of aged rag paper, dense iron gall ink, and ledger rules. 

Visually, the system balances the literary authority of fine editorial print with the strict tabular clarity of mercantile account books. Content feels permanent and valued, treating home economics and domestic cooking as disciplines deserving archival care.

## Layout & Spacing

The structural layout mirrors open accounting ledger folios:

- **Desktop Architecture (≥ 1024px):** A persistent 248px left sidebar clad in Dark Forest (`#183A32`) anchors the navigation, housing the triad modules: *Compra*, *Recetas*, and *Calorías*. The adjacent work surface utilizes a structured fluid grid with 24px gutters (`1.5rem`) and 32px outer canvas padding (`2rem`), maintaining a maximum content reading width of 1280px.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** The sidebar collapses into an 72px icon-and-label vertical strip. Margins compress to 24px (`1.5rem`).
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Navigation transitions to a persistent top masthead with a bottom-anchored module drawer. Margins adjust to 16px (`1rem`).
- **Rhythm & Touch Standards:** All interactive inputs, ledger rows, and primary actions adhere to a strict minimum target height of 44px, ensuring deliberate, error-free physical ergonomics.

## Elevation & Depth

This system avoids ambient drop shadows, blurred depth maps, and floating Z-axis elevations. Physical hierarchy is communicated solely through **tonal layering** and **hairline ruled borders**:

1. **Base Layer:** The global application background is the raw paper canvas (`#F4F0E8`).
2. **Document Layer:** Inset data workspaces, document panels, recipe folios, and ledger spreads sit at `#FBF9F4`, outlined with crisp, flat `1px solid #D8D2C7` hair-line rules.
3. **Hover & Focus Depths:** Modals and dropdown flyouts do not produce diffused ambient shadows; they feature a direct 1px solid border (`#D8D2C7`) backed by a deliberate, hard offset line shadow: `box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px rgba(24, 58, 50, 0.08)`.
4. **Active Row Depth:** Hover states within tabular sheets register through pure background shift to Sand (`#EAE4D7`), reinforcing physical paper contact rather than optical lift.

## Components

### Buttons & Navigation Triggers
- **Primary Action:** Solid Dark Forest (`#183A32`) fill, cream paper text (`#FBF9F4`), 44px height, 4px border radius. Hover transitions to `#224D43`. Focus presents a crisp 2px hairline ring in Terracotta (`#A94D36`).
- **Secondary Action:** Transparent base, 1px solid hairline (`#D8D2C7`), Ink text (`#202724`). Hover fills with Sand Highlight (`#EAE4D7`).
- **Terracotta Accent Button:** Used strictly for recording entries or final checkout lists: solid `#A94D36`, white text, 44px height.

### Input Fields & Search Ledgers
- Height: 44px minimum touch frame.
- Background: `#FBF9F4` surface paper.
- Border: 1px solid `#D8D2C7`, transitioning to 1px solid `#183A32` on focus with no glowing outline.
- Typography: 14px IBM Plex Sans in `#202724`; placeholder text in `#536158`.

### Checkboxes & Selection Rows
- Dimensions: Square 18px × 18px box, 2px border radius, 1.5px solid `#536158`.
- Checked State: Solid `#183A32` fill with a crisp `#FBF9F4` check mark. When an item is marked in *Compra*, line items apply an ink-fade to `#536158` with a fine hairline strikethrough.

### Tabular Ledger (Accounting & Calories)
- Tables feature flat border-collapse styling with `1px solid #D8D2C7` bottom borders.
- Header row: Fraunces 14px italicized or IBM Plex Sans 12px uppercase tracking, styled in Secondary Ink (`#536158`).
- Numeric Columns: IBM Plex Sans Tabular (`tnum`), right-aligned, zero-padded alignment for currency (€) and energy (kcal).
- Alternating Zebra Striping: Unfilled `#FBF9F4` to muted `#EAE4D7`.

### Recipe & Folio Cards
- Background: Surface paper (`#FBF9F4`), bordered by 1px solid `#D8D2C7`.
- Padding: `1.5rem` (`space-lg`).
- Header: 22px Fraunces headline over a horizontal 1px rule running edge-to-edge.
- Badges/Chips: Bordered chips (1px `#D8D2C7`) with Sand fill (`#EAE4D7`), 12px IBM Plex Sans, no pill rounding (4px corner radius).

### System Disclaimer Tag
- Static label placed in the header, ledger footer, and sidebar footers reading: `DATOS DE DEMOSTRACIÓN`.

## Brand & Style

This design system draws inspiration from historic domestic archives, bound culinary folios, and classical double-entry household ledgers. It is designed for domestic record-keeping across three integrated modules: pantry replenishment (*Compra*), recipe preservation (*Recetas*), and nutritional accounting (*Calorías*).

The emotional tone is quiet, scholarly, grounded, and dignified. It rejects modern digital tropes: no translucent glass panels, no saturated synthetic gradients, no hyper-rounded playful containers, and no gamified guilt metrics. Instead, the interface adopts the physical honesty of aged rag paper, dense iron gall ink, and ledger rules. 

Visually, the system balances the literary authority of fine editorial print with the strict tabular clarity of mercantile account books. Content feels permanent and valued, treating home economics and domestic cooking as disciplines deserving archival care.

## Colors

The palette simulates tactile parchment, physical ledger inks, and mineral pigments:

- **Canvas Background (`#F4F0E8`):** A warm, unbleached rag paper tone serving as the foundational viewport background.
- **Surface Layer (`#FBF9F4`):** A lighter, refined paper sheet used for inset panels, ledger sheets, records, and recipe folios.
- **Dark Forest (`#183A32`):** Deep botanical green serving as the structural spine, persistent navigation container, and primary action surface.
- **Dark Forest Hover (`#224D43`):** Subtle lifted state for interactive components anchored on forest surfaces.
- **Ink (`#202724`):** Near-black iron ink for primary typography, titles, and dense ledger totals.
- **Secondary Ink (`#536158`):** Muted botanical grey-green for metadata, unit labels, timestamps, and secondary captions.
- **Terracotta Accent (`#A94D36`):** Mineral red-clay pigment used with strict restraint for ledger deficit indicators, primary selections, active tab markers, and non-aggressive warnings.
- **Fine Rule / Border (`#D8D2C7`):** Hairline structural separation echoing ruled folio paper.
- **Sand Highlight (`#EAE4D7`):** Muted surface highlight for alternating ledger rows, selected table cells, and subtle chips.

## Typography

Typography establishes an archival cadence through deliberate pairing:
- **Display & Section Titles:** Set in **Fraunces**, bringing warmth, variable optical presence, and an authentic editorial heritage. Page titles sit at 32px (`headline-xl`), with section headings at 22px (`headline-lg`).
- **Body & Tabular Interface:** Set in **IBM Plex Sans** for clarity, neutral functionality, and uncompromised legibility across density-rich logs. Base body copy resides at 16px (`body-lg`), while ledger line items and compact tables operate at 14px (`body-md`).
- **Tabular Figures:** All financial currencies, quantities, weights (g/kg), and nutritional metrics utilize font-variant numeric settings (`tnum`, `lnum`) to preserve vertical ledger alignment.
- **Editorial Disclaimer:** The ubiquitous label `Datos de demostración` renders in uppercase 11px IBM Plex Sans (`disclaimer-xs`) with tracked letter-spacing (+0.06em) and subdued secondary ink coloring.

## Layout & Spacing

The structural layout mirrors open accounting ledger folios:

- **Desktop Architecture (≥ 1024px):** A persistent 248px left sidebar clad in Dark Forest (`#183A32`) anchors the navigation, housing the triad modules: *Compra*, *Recetas*, and *Calorías*. The adjacent work surface utilizes a structured fluid grid with 24px gutters (`1.5rem`) and 32px outer canvas padding (`2rem`), maintaining a maximum content reading width of 1280px.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** The sidebar collapses into an 72px icon-and-label vertical strip. Margins compress to 24px (`1.5rem`).
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Navigation transitions to a persistent top masthead with a bottom-anchored module drawer. Margins adjust to 16px (`1rem`).
- **Rhythm & Touch Standards:** All interactive inputs, ledger rows, and primary actions adhere to a strict minimum target height of 44px, ensuring deliberate, error-free physical ergonomics.

## Elevation & Depth

This system avoids ambient drop shadows, blurred depth maps, and floating Z-axis elevations. Physical hierarchy is communicated solely through **tonal layering** and **hairline ruled borders**:

1. **Base Layer:** The global application background is the raw paper canvas (`#F4F0E8`).
2. **Document Layer:** Inset data workspaces, document panels, recipe folios, and ledger spreads sit at `#FBF9F4`, outlined with crisp, flat `1px solid #D8D2C7` hair-line rules.
3. **Hover & Focus Depths:** Modals and dropdown flyouts do not produce diffused ambient shadows; they feature a direct 1px solid border (`#D8D2C7`) backed by a deliberate, hard offset line shadow: `box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px rgba(24, 58, 50, 0.08)`.
4. **Active Row Depth:** Hover states within tabular sheets register through pure background shift to Sand (`#EAE4D7`), reinforcing physical paper contact rather than optical lift.

## Shapes

Shapes emulate bookbinder corner cuts, ledger cards, and trimmed paper slips. 

The system standardizes on **Soft (0.25rem / 4px)** corner radius for input fields, buttons, and interior cards. Sheet panels and primary ledger containers can employ either zero radius (sharp folio edge) or a restrained 4px radius. 

Large pill shapes, circular action buttons, and exaggerated bubble radii are strictly forbidden, as they undermine the historical and scholarly precision of the archive.

## Components

### Buttons & Navigation Triggers

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system draws inspiration from historic domestic archives, bound culinary folios, and classical double-entry household ledgers. It is designed for domestic record-keeping across three integrated modules: pantry replenishment (*Compra*), recipe preservation (*Recetas*), and nutritional accounting (*Calorías*).

The emotional tone is quiet, scholarly, grounded, and dignified. It rejects modern digital tropes: no translucent glass panels, no saturated synthetic gradients, no hyper-rounded playful containers, and no gamified guilt metrics. Instead, the interface adopts the physical honesty of aged rag paper, dense iron gall ink, and ledger rules. 

Visually, the system balances the literary authority of fine editorial print with the strict tabular clarity of mercantile account books. Content feels permanent and valued, treating home economics and domestic cooking as disciplines deserving archival care.

## Layout & Spacing

The structural layout mirrors open accounting ledger folios:

- **Desktop Architecture (≥ 1024px):** A persistent 248px left sidebar clad in Dark Forest (`#183A32`) anchors the navigation, housing the triad modules: *Compra*, *Recetas*, and *Calorías*. The adjacent work surface utilizes a structured fluid grid with 24px gutters (`1.5rem`) and 32px outer canvas padding (`2rem`), maintaining a maximum content reading width of 1280px.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** The sidebar collapses into an 72px icon-and-label vertical strip. Margins compress to 24px (`1.5rem`).
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Navigation transitions to a persistent top masthead with a bottom-anchored module drawer. Margins adjust to 16px (`1rem`).
- **Rhythm & Touch Standards:** All interactive inputs, ledger rows, and primary actions adhere to a strict minimum target height of 44px, ensuring deliberate, error-free physical ergonomics.

## Elevation & Depth

This system avoids ambient drop shadows, blurred depth maps, and floating Z-axis elevations. Physical hierarchy is communicated solely through **tonal layering** and **hairline ruled borders**:

1. **Base Layer:** The global application background is the raw paper canvas (`#F4F0E8`).
2. **Document Layer:** Inset data workspaces, document panels, recipe folios, and ledger spreads sit at `#FBF9F4`, outlined with crisp, flat `1px solid #D8D2C7` hair-line rules.
3. **Hover & Focus Depths:** Modals and dropdown flyouts do not produce diffused ambient shadows; they feature a direct 1px solid border (`#D8D2C7`) backed by a deliberate, hard offset line shadow: `box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px rgba(24, 58, 50, 0.08)`.
4. **Active Row Depth:** Hover states within tabular sheets register through pure background shift to Sand (`#EAE4D7`), reinforcing physical paper contact rather than optical lift.

## Components

### Buttons & Navigation Triggers
- **Primary Action:** Solid Dark Forest (`#183A32`) fill, cream paper text (`#FBF9F4`), 44px height, 4px border radius. Hover transitions to `#224D43`. Focus presents a crisp 2px hairline ring in Terracotta (`#A94D36`).
- **Secondary Action:** Transparent base, 1px solid hairline (`#D8D2C7`), Ink text (`#202724`). Hover fills with Sand Highlight (`#EAE4D7`).
- **Terracotta Accent Button:** Used strictly for recording entries or final checkout lists: solid `#A94D36`, white text, 44px height.

### Input Fields & Search Ledgers
- Height: 44px minimum touch frame.
- Background: `#FBF9F4` surface paper.
- Border: 1px solid `#D8D2C7`, transitioning to 1px solid `#183A32` on focus with no glowing outline.
- Typography: 14px IBM Plex Sans in `#202724`; placeholder text in `#536158`.

### Checkboxes & Selection Rows
- Dimensions: Square 18px × 18px box, 2px border radius, 1.5px solid `#536158`.
- Checked State: Solid `#183A32` fill with a crisp `#FBF9F4` check mark. When an item is marked in *Compra*, line items apply an ink-fade to `#536158` with a fine hairline strikethrough.

### Tabular Ledger (Accounting & Calories)
- Tables feature flat border-collapse styling with `1px solid #D8D2C7` bottom borders.
- Header row: Fraunces 14px italicized or IBM Plex Sans 12px uppercase tracking, styled in Secondary Ink (`#536158`).
- Numeric Columns: IBM Plex Sans Tabular (`tnum`), right-aligned, zero-padded alignment for currency (€) and energy (kcal).
- Alternating Zebra Striping: Unfilled `#FBF9F4` to muted `#EAE4D7`.

### Recipe & Folio Cards
- Background: Surface paper (`#FBF9F4`), bordered by 1px solid `#D8D2C7`.
- Padding: `1.5rem` (`space-lg`).
- Header: 22px Fraunces headline over a horizontal 1px rule running edge-to-edge.
- Badges/Chips: Bordered chips (1px `#D8D2C7`) with Sand fill (`#EAE4D7`), 12px IBM Plex Sans, no pill rounding (4px corner radius).

### System Disclaimer Tag
- Static label placed in the header, ledger footer, and sidebar footers reading: `DATOS DE DEMOSTRACIÓN`.
- Styled in 11px uppercase IBM Plex Sans, Secondary Ink (`#536158`), encased in a soft hairline box padding of `2px 6px`.

Theme & Palette:
- Paper background: #F4F0E8
- Surface cards / container: #FBF9F4
- Dark forest sidebar: #183A32 (deep forest green)
- Ink text: #202724
- Secondary muted text / borders: #536158 and subtle border tones
- Restrained terracotta accent: #A94D36 (used sparingly for primary actions or emphasis)

Typography & Spacing:
- Headlines: Fraunces (serif, editorial tone, e.g. 32px for main title).
- Body: IBM Plex Sans 16px.
- Metadata / captions: 13px.
- Numeric / energy figures: Tabular lining digits.
- Controls / touch targets: minimum 44px height.

1. Sidebar (width: 248px, fixed left, dark forest #183A32):
   - Header: Cesta Monogram "C", "Cesta", "ARCHIVO DEL HOGAR".
   - Top CTA button: "Registrar Entrada" (restrained terracotta #A94D36).
   - Module section:
     - "Compra" (collapsed/inactive)
     - "Recetas" (collapsed/inactive)
     - "Calorías" (ACTIVE, highlighted, with dot indicator)
       - Sub-navigation under Calorías:
         * "Mi diario" (ACTIVE item)
         * "Mis alimentos"
         * "Tendencias"
   - Footer links in sidebar:
     - "Ajustes", "Aprender"
     - Subtle badge: "MAQUETA — DATOS DE EJEMPLO"

   - Header Bar / Masthead:
     - Top row: Breadcrumb/Category: "Cesta / Cuaderno de Calorías"

     - Units clearly indicated in kcal.

     - NO 2000 kcal progress rings, NO daily calorie limit indicators, NO red guilt warnings or weight loss advice.

4. Daily Meal Sections (Desayuno, Comida / Almuerzo, Cena):

     - Meal actions row: Buttons "+ Añadir alimento" and "Usar receta guardada" (both min 44px).

     - Row 1: "Guiso casero de verduras de huerta" | 320 g | Macros: "Sin dato" (distinctly marked as Sin dato, NOT 0 or null) | Kcal: "Sin dato".
     - Row 2: "Lomo de lubina al horno con patata panadera" | 220 g | 390 kcal | Macros: 38g P · 22g C · 14g G | [Editar].

outputComponents.text:
He diseñado la pantalla de escritorio **«Cesta — Calorías / Mi diario»** ajustada estrictamente a un ancho de 1440px y alineada al sistema editorial de Cesta.

### Decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de información:
- **Atmósfera y paleta editorial:** Fondo papel (`#F4F0E8`), tarjetas en superficie crema (`#FBF9F4`), tipografía de títulos en **Fraunces** (32px), cuerpo y metadatos en **IBM Plex Sans** (16px y 13px) con cifras tabulares para valores de energía, y acentos medidos en terracota (`#A94D36`).
- **Navegación lateral de 248px:** Menú bosque (`#183A32`) con **Calorías** activo y desplegado únicamente con sus subsecciones (*Mi diario* activo, *Mis alimentos*, *Tendencias*), y pie con *Ajustes*, *Aprender* y la etiqueta visible *Maqueta — Datos de ejemplo*.
- **Privacidad y serenidad sin juicio:** Indicador destacado *«Solo tú puedes ver este diario»* con selector de fecha ágil (*Ayer*, *24 de Octubre de 2024*, *Mañana*, *Hoy*). Se evitan explícitamente metas calóricas impuestas, aros de 2000 kcal o lenguaje de culpabilidad.
- **Observación semanal de 7 días:** Gráfico sereno de barras con una jornada sin registro (*«Pausa natural»*) y otra con *«Registro parcial»*, con enlace directo a consulta tabular.
- **Estructura de tomas diarias (Desayuno, Comida, Cena):** Desglose detallado con porciones en gramos, calorías y macronutrientes. En la comida, el guiso casero figura explícitamente como **«Sin dato»** (sin forzar ceros artificiales) con su llamada de acción para completar.
- **Acciones y controles táctiles:** Botones de al menos 44px (*«+ Añadir alimento»*, *«Usar receta guardada»*, *«Editar»*, *«Exportar día»* y *«+ Registro rápido»*), completamente desvinculados de listas de la compra o catálogos de recetas externos.
